newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Tiara Asia completes $20 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank Tiara Asia completes $20 mln loan.

text.p: PT Bank Tiara Asia signed a US$20 million multi-bilateral term loan facility with six international banks, the arrangers said.
The loan has a maturity of three years and pays a margin of 90 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate.
Arrangers are AFC Merchant Bank with US$4 million, Indover Bank with US$5 million, and Sanwa Bank's Singapore branch with US$3 million.
Other lenders participating are Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Singapore branch and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp with US$3 million each, and Bank Austria's Singapore branch with US$2 million.
